title: A PR whose CI began before a migration PR merged still failed check:migrations, because no open PR carried the file any more

source.ref: ci checks job 109731256322 (#3108), 2026-09-30 03:54Z: ledger-only 20270345011400 circle_channels; #3107 carrying it merged at 03:53Z

detail:
FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-30. MEASURED: HYG-158 (ADR-1690) forgives a ledger row with no repo file on a PR that touches no migration only when another OPEN pull request carries the exact file. #3108's merge ref was built at 03:50Z; LIVE-666's PR #3107, carrying 20270345011400_circle_channels, merged at 03:53Z; #3108's check:migrations ran at 03:54Z, found no open carrier and failed, though the file was already on main. WHAT CHANGED: findInFlightCarriers first reads the base tip the workflow already fetched (git ls-tree origin/<base>), and a row whose exact file is there counts as carried (the line says 'already on main; update this branch'), with no API read; only rows not found there go to the open-PR lookup. Every other condition of HYG-158 stands: no migration in this PR's diff, drift made only of ledger rows newer than the tree, and a failure to look is strict. Main's own runs never reach this path.

CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1695). scripts/check-migrations.test.ts covers the base-tip hit with zero API calls and the fall-through when the base tip was not fetched.

verify.cmd: node --input-type=module -e "import {findInFlightCarriers} from './scripts/check-migrations.mjs';const rows=[{version:'20990101000000',name:'x'}];const git=(a)=>a.includes('origin/main')?'supabase/migrations/20990101000000_x.sql\\n':'';const fetchImpl=async()=>{throw new Error('API must not be asked')};const c=await findInFlightCarriers({rows,env:{GITHUB_BASE_REF:'main'},fetchImpl,git});if(c.get('20990101000000')!=='main'){console.error('HYG-159: a migration already merged to the base tip must count as carried without an API read',[...c]);process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: The consequence: a ledger row whose file is on origin/<base> counts as carried without touching the API. On main before this change the function throws without a token (or asks the API) and never returns the base branch.
